source.description: Source platform or repository (e.g., Hugging Face, Kaggle, GitHub)

organization.description: Organization or institution that published the dataset

url.description: Main URL or landing page for the dataset

landing_page.description: Direct landing page URL (if different from main URL)

api_url.description: API endpoint for programmatic access (if available)

license.description: License under which the dataset is distributed

license_url.description: URL to the full license text

publication_date.description: Date when the dataset was first published

last_updated.description: Date when the dataset was last updated

geographic_coverage.description: Geographic area covered by the dataset (e.g., 'Delhi, India', 'Global')

temporal_coverage.description: Time period covered by the dataset (e.g., '2010-2020', '1980-present')

spatial_resolution.description: Spatial resolution of the data (e.g., '1km', '30m', '0.1 degree')

variables.description: List of variables or features in the dataset

file_size.description: Size of the dataset files (e.g., '2.5 GB', '150 MB')

record_count.description: Number of records or observations in the dataset

access_method.description: How to access the data (e.g., 'direct download', 'API', 'web interface')

authentication_required.description: Whether authentication is required to access the dataset

documentation_url.description: URL to documentation or README for the dataset

paper_url.description: URL to associated research paper (if applicable)

provenance.description: Information about the dataset's origins and processing history
